summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing that FMR LLC’s aggregate voting rights in Nokia decreased below 5% as of June 29, 2026. The filing is a routine cross-border threshold notification under Finnish law (Chapter 9, Section 10 of the FSMA), equivalent to a Schedule 13D/13G amendment in the US. No transaction, offer, or corporate action is involved; the filing merely reports a passive stake reduction. This is not a special situation — it is a standard beneficial ownership disclosure.
